notes: Educational Jupyter course (Microsoft 'AI Agents for Beginners'). JupyterLab serves the repo on port 3000 with token auth disabled. Dependencies are installed into the image (Dockerfile.base44); the repo is bind-mounted at /workspace. Notebooks call Microsoft Foundry / Azure OpenAI and only execute with the user's own credentials plus an Azure sign-in (AzureCliCredential -> `az login`), which is not available inside the sandbox container.

secrets.name: AZURE_AI_PROJECT_ENDPOINT
secrets.description: Microsoft Foundry project endpoint (https://<resource>.services.ai.azure.com/api/projects/<project>). Required to run most lesson notebooks.

secrets.name: AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT
secrets.description: Azure OpenAI resource endpoint (https://<resource>.openai.azure.com) used by notebooks that call the model directly. Found in the Azure portal, Azure OpenAI resource -> Keys and Endpoint.

secrets.name: AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Azure OpenAI API key (Azure portal -> Azure OpenAI resource -> Keys and Endpoint -> KEY1). Alternative to Entra ID sign-in, which is unavailable in the sandbox.

secrets.name: AZURE_SEARCH_SERVICE_ENDPOINT
secrets.description: Azure AI Search service endpoint, needed for Lesson 05 (Agentic RAG). Azure portal -> AI Search service -> Url.

secrets.name: AZURE_SEARCH_API_KEY
secrets.description: Azure AI Search admin/query key, needed for Lesson 05 (Agentic RAG). Azure portal -> AI Search service -> Keys.

secrets.name: BING_CONNECTION_ID
secrets.description: Azure AI Bing grounding connection id, needed for Lesson 08 (multi-agent Bing grounding workflow).

secrets.name: MINIMAX_API_KEY
secrets.description: MiniMax API key (https://platform.minimaxi.com/) — optional OpenAI-compatible alternative provider used by some samples.
